verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Revenue is a state tax agency whose filing and payment portal holds taxpayer data under its own jurisdiction. User-selectable storage region or residency is a cloud/SaaS axis that does not fit this kind of government service. Nothing in the evidence shows the portal offers any data-location choice that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
